text: More than 150 years ago, new ideas, like those of Charles Darwin, made many people doubt old beliefs.
Modernists were artists and writers who turned away from old traditions to find new ways of making art.
src: Charles Darwin’s On the Origin of Species (1859) undermined religious certainty / shaped by the ideas of Darwin, Marx, Nietzsche, Freud and Bergson
Modernism was marked by a self-conscious rejection of tradition and a search for new means of expression

text: More than 100 years ago, Pablo Picasso and other painters began a new style called Cubism.
Painters stopped copying nature and made colour and shape the heart of their art.
src: Fauvism and Cubism arose in the studios of Henri Matisse, Pablo Picasso and Georges Braque between 1900 and 1910
Painters rejected traditional perspective and took colour and shape, not the depiction of nature, as the essence of art

text: Writers like James Joyce and Virginia Woolf wrote stories that follow the flow of a character's thoughts.
Many people were shocked, and some of the new books, poems and music were hard to understand.
src: Writers took up the stream of consciousness / James Joyce and Virginia Woolf became its best-known novelists
Its experiments often startled and alienated audiences, with novels that rejected intelligible plots, poetry that defied clear interpretation and music of extreme dissonance

text: The Nazis insulted modern art as "degenerate" and stopped many artists from showing or even making their art.
Many artists left for the Americas, and after the war New York became the new centre of art.
src: the Nazis, who called virtually all modern art “degenerate” / forbidden to exhibit, to sell or even to make art
and many left for the Americas / After 1945 the centre of the art world moved from Paris to New York

text: Wassily Kandinsky made art from pure colour, and called one of his works the first abstract painting.
Today most big cities have museums of modern art, such as the Tate Modern in London.
src: Wassily Kandinsky, Piet Mondrian and Kazimir Malevich sought to redefine art as the arrangement of pure colour / Kandinsky paints what he later called the first abstract painting
Most major cities now have museums of modern art, such as the Museum of Modern Art in New York, the Tate Modern in London
